'''Sonng Tarvo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a Pistoleer [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed in the [[Carrick Station]].
